name: Rakle Works Raw Feeding Calculator
author: rakleworks

sections.description:
Rakle Works Raw Feeding Calculator helps dog owners estimate how much raw food to feed their dog each day.

Users can enter their dog’s weight, select a feeding goal (maintain weight, weight loss, weight gain, or puppy/active), and choose the number of meals per day. The calculator displays the estimated daily feeding amount and a per-meal breakdown.

The plugin includes an admin settings page where site owners can adjust feeding percentages, default units (kg or lb), default meals per day, calculator title/subtitle, button text, and basic styling options. Optional “Powered by” attribution is available and disabled by default (opt-in).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Add the shortcode [raklwora_raw_feeding_calculator] to any page
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. Add the shortcode using an Elementor Shortcode widget.

Can I show a “Powered by” credit?

Yes, but it is disabled by default. You can enable it in the plugin settings (opt-in).
